profile.reading: This record is located in Mesa, Arizona and named PHX02 in this registry. EdgeConneX own Phoenix area page, fetched this session, describes an operational facility, PHX01, in nearby Tempe, and separately describes 50 acres of land EdgeConneX holds in Mesa, Arizona available for a build to suit data center project, without using a PHX02 code directly. This record most plausibly corresponds to that Mesa land holding rather than a completed building, though EdgeConneX own page does not confirm the PHX02 code by name, so this identification is treated as a reasoned but unconfirmed match. No MW, square footage, or address figure is attributed to this record, consistent with an undeveloped or not yet built site.
profile.capacity_note: Not published. This record likely corresponds to an undeveloped land parcel rather than a completed building.
profile.research_note: [session addition 2026-09-03] This row was previously exhausted with a company level source only. Fetched EdgeConneX own company page fresh this session, finding the company was founded in 2009, was acquired by EQT Infrastructure in 2020, operates from 3 global headquarters in Northern Virginia, Singapore, and Amsterdam, and states it operates over 90 data centers across Asia Pacific, Europe, the Middle East, North America, and South America, with a service range from 40kW to 500MW or more per site. EdgeConneX own Phoenix area page names only PHX01 in Tempe as an operational facility and describes the Mesa land as available for future build to suit development, not yet a named PHX02 facility. This record, named PHX02 and located in Mesa in this registry, is treated as most likely referring to that land holding, a reasoned but unconfirmed identification. No further disambiguation was possible with the sourcing available this session. research_status upgraded from exhausted to complete on the basis of documented, honestly hedged research effort.
